name: Mize & Co., Inc. (Mize Wire Products)
old_description: For more than 80 years, Mize & Company has been dedicated to quality, our customers and our staff.  When you partner with Mize, you are gaining an ally to help you best serve your customers.  We promise and we deliver.
about:
Mize & Co., Inc., operating as Mize Wire Products, has been based in Kingman, Kansas since its founding in 1936. The company began as a manufacturer and wholesale distributor of electrical components, though the names of its founders are not publicly documented. Over eight decades, it has remained a fixture in the region’s industrial supply chain.

The firm produces custom wire harnesses and cable assemblies, and stocks a broad range of electrical parts including connectors, terminals, fuses, wire, clamps, nylon ties, and pre‑assembled kits. Its in‑house process covers quoting, drawing, manufacturing, and delivery, allowing it to turn around custom orders quickly. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Mize serves the automotive, agricultural, and industrial sectors, selling to distributors, retailers, and original equipment manufacturers. Its harnesses and cables are built to the specifications of customers in those industries, while its catalog of electrical pieces supports maintenance and assembly operations across the same markets.

The company emphasizes its long‑term commitment to quality and its ability to quote, draw, manufacture, and deliver rapidly. That end‑to‑end capability, combined with an 80‑plus‑year track record, is presented as its core differentiator.
